explanation: The publication identity rule lives in scripts/lib/studyRecord.mts and governs the study pages and the agent export; it decides which paper is cited, not QC, design or author-concordance evidence. Main's bundle-reader adoption leaves macaqueQc.mts, replicationEvidence.mts and historicalEvidence.mts on their own parsers because they are fingerprinted or sealed. Verification commands, ledgers and evidence rules are unchanged.
